statement: The recorded +15 mm limit is unsafe and incorrect for this case because the stage collides at +8 mm, so I will run the 41-point scan from −5 to +5 mm instead.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded +15 mm limit is unsafe and incorrect... because the stage collides at +8 mm" directly asserts the value is wrong and gives a corrected range.
